entities.summary: Al-Makassed Islamic Charitable Society Hospital is a Muslim Community founded teaching hospital and charitable hospital of the Palestinian Arab's charitable founded by Makassed Islamic Charitable Society. There is one of district general hospital from part of six hospitals in the East Jerusalem Hospitals Network. It has 250 beds and is situated on Mount of Olives in East Jerusalem. It serves as a tertiary referral hospital mainly for the Arab population of the Palestinian territories, namely the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, but also provides health care for the Israeli population when they meet obstacles using other facilities.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a tertiary referral hospital serving the Arab population of the Palestinian territories and providing healthcare to Israeli patients facing obstacles with other facilities, Makassed Hospital plays a crucial role in addressing health disparities in the region. With 250 beds, it is an essential institution for the local community.
